#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD_CONST = 1000000007;

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long cur = base % mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = (result * cur) % mod;
        }
        cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int total, factor;
    cin >> total >> factor;

    vector<int> arr(total);
    for (int i = 0; i < total; ++i) {
        arr[i] = (factor * i) % total;
    }

    if (factor == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(total, total - 1, MOD_CONST) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<bool> visited_list(total, false);
    vector<int> cycle_count(total, 0);
    long long total_result = 1;

    for (int start_point = 0; start_point < total; ++start_point) {
        if (visited_list[start_point]) continue;
        int length = 0;
        int current = start_point;
        while (!visited_list[current]) {
            visited_list[current] = true;
            current = arr[current];
            ++length;
        }
        cycle_count[length]++;
    }

    for (int length = 1; length < total; ++length) {
        int c = cycle_count[length];
        if (c != 0) {
            long long total_val = (long long)length * c + (length > 1 ? 1 : 0);
            total_result = (total_result * mod_pow(total_val, c, MOD_CONST)) % MOD_CONST;
        }
    }

    cout << total_result << "\n";

    return 0;
}
